Default.beforeNextRoundText:
You can take 30 seconds to review any cards you missed!

Click the eyeball icons for your team's original deck and Discard pile to see what's in there.
Default.fmtReviewWords: Take 30 seconds to review your team's words before the next round!
Default.tutorialWhoQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.tut1Text: You're randomly placed on the Red or Blue team, and the game has 3 rounds. At the start of each round, one player from each team volunteers to be the Cluegiver. Each Cluegiver gets a deck of 20 phrase cards. Team Red goes first!
Default.tut2Text: The Cluegiver is dealt one card at a time and describes the phrase on it — following that round's constraint — until a teammate guesses it correctly. Then tap the card to draw the next one. Stuck? Tap Pass to move the card to your discard pile and draw a new one.
Default.tut3Text: Each turn lasts 45 seconds, then the other team's Cluegiver takes over. Teams alternate back and forth until one team has guessed all their cards, which ends the round. (If Red finishes first, Blue still gets one final turn.) Run out of cards mid-turn? Your discards are reshuffled so you can try them again.
Default.tut4Text: When a round ends, the winning team scores points equal to the number of cards the other team could NOT guess (their remaining deck plus discard pile). After all 3 rounds, the team with the most points wins!
Default.tut5Text: Here's the twist: each team's deck stays the same every round. Rounds 2 and 3 use the exact same cards as Round 1 — so pay close attention early on!
Default.tut6Text:
The catch is how you can give clues each round:

Round 1: describe freely, but never say a word printed on the card.
Round 2: you may use only ONE word.
Round 3: no talking — you must act it out!

value.1: Words, sounds and acting are allowed. Teams can’t use any part of the phrase on the card. Each card guessed correctly is worth 1 point!
value.2: Only one word per card. No acting. Teams can’t use any part of the phrase on the card. Each card guessed correctly is worth 2 points!
value.3: Acting only. No words or sounds. Each card guessed correctly is worth 3 points!
